//: Example MCP server registration. Claude Code auto-loads a project-level .mcp.json, or register globally with `claude mcp add`. When the agent runs inside a Neovim :terminal, $NVIM is inherited automatically and nvim-mcp connects back to that editor — no extra configuration needed. The --display flag chooses where the agent's command execution is surfaced: panel | hidden | log (it can also be set via the NVIM_MCP_EXEC_DISPLAY env var). The :ClaudeCode plugin generates this file for you.
